verdict: McDonald's grew revenue 9% to $6.5B and operating profit 12% — global comparable sales rose 3.8%, with the U.S. bouncing back to +3.9% after last year's dip.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: vs a year ago (+4% in constant currencies)

segments.name: Franchised restaurants
segments.note: Rent and royalties paid by the local owners who run most McDonald's restaurants — the heart of the business model.

segments.name: Company-owned restaurants
segments.note: Food and drink sold at restaurants McDonald's runs itself.

segments.name: Other revenues
segments.note: Fees from franchisees for technology and digital platforms, plus brand-licensing income.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Head office, marketing support and running the global franchising machine — includes $111M of depreciation and amortization.

takeaways.title: Comps bounced back
takeaways.text: Global comparable sales rose 3.8% — the U.S. +3.9% (versus -3.6% a year ago) on higher checks, International Operated Markets +3.9% and licensed markets +3.4%. Systemwide sales across all restaurants rose 11% to over $34B.

takeaways.title: EPS rose 7%
takeaways.text: Diluted EPS was $2.78, up 7% (currency flattered it by $0.13). Excluding $47M of restructuring charges tied to the 'Accelerating the Organization' program, it was $2.83. Operating income rose 12% to $3.0B.

takeaways.title: Franchisees carry the model
takeaways.text: Franchise revenue — rent and royalties from other people's restaurants — was $4.0B, 61% of all revenue, and produced $3.3B of margin. Company-run stores brought in most of the rest at much thinner margins ($285M).

oneTimers: Pre-tax charges of $47M ($0.05 per share) for restructuring under the 'Accelerating the Organization' program; the year-ago quarter had $66M of similar charges. Excluding them, operating income rose 11%.
otherDetail: Interest expense of $400M on McDonald's debt, plus $11M of net nonoperating expense.
footerNote: Restaurant costs are shown net of $69M of other operating income (gains on restaurant sales and equity earnings, less $47M of impairment and restructuring charges), and include $166M of 'other restaurant expenses' from the 10-Q.
